narrative_structure.total: 20-50 s (9:16). Short cuts 15 s later for A/B.

beats.rule: pattern interrupt visual + curiosity/tension line; first word at <0.5 s
noise, guessing, being alone; new visual beat every 2-3 s; open loop ('but one thing…')
guidance appears (AI guide, light, path); calm
show the ecosystem: community, app (generic UI, no numbers), academy; pay off the open loop
end card integrated in the video's style, VO CTA lands exactly when logo appears, risk line ≥4 s

narrative_structure.shot_length: 2-4 s per shot, 0.4-0.6 s crossfades, no hard cuts
narrative_structure.proof: No 'proof' beat with results/testimonials; proof = transparency and real community, never numbers.

positioning.say: algoria AI = an ecosystem that accompanies you: AI-powered guidance, a FREE public community group where people share and learn, a FREE app, an academy full of lessons.
never_say: algorithm that trades gold for you
positioning.cta: Join the free algoria community. No deposit. No purchase required.

brand_and_compliance.logo: real PNG only (algoria-mark.png + 'ALGORIA AI' in Space Grotesk on dark); never AI-generated logo text
brand_and_compliance.risk_line: Education & community only. Not financial advice. Trading involves significant risk and you can lose the capital you invest. Past performance does not guarantee future results. (small, ~25 px, end card, ≥4 s; on every carousel slide)
never: promise of gains, amounts, %, P&L curves, profit screenshots
member names/IDs, MT5/MetaApi/broker IDs, admin, tokens
brand_and_compliance.process: Nothing is published or sent without Mathieu's explicit OK; UAE/SCA licensing may need legal review.

brief_input_format.theme: one of themes or free text

negative: text, letters, logos, watermark, extra fingers, face morphing, red/green arrows, money, numbers
